briefing.text: Anthropic closed its first trading day at $97.17, up 17% from its $83 IPO price.
GTA VI is out worldwide with a 99 on Metacritic and reported $2B+ launch-day sales.
The Hunger Games prequel opens today, forecast at $100 million to $120 million.
Nvidia says it plans no more H200 chip shipments to China.
Google launched Gemini 4 Neon, its new AI model with a 1 million token context.

stories.title: GTA VI is out and has a 99 on Metacritic, the joint highest score the site lists
stories.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI rolled out worldwide from November 18 in New Zealand to the Americas on November 19, with a 99 on Metacritic.
stories.why: It is the most anticipated game in years, and its sales are seen as a test for the whole console market.
stories.happened: The score ties The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. Pre-orders were reported above $1.5 billion by Sensor Tower, and Deadline reports launch-day sales passing $2 billion. Rockstar has not released an official sales figure.
stories.next: Watch for Take-Two's first official sales number and any news on a PC version.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Pre-orders were reported above $1.5 billion before launch day.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans waited 13 years since GTA V.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The 99 ties The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.

stories.background: Rockstar Games is owned by Take-Two Interactive and also made Red Dead Redemption.

meme.take: GTA VI scores a 99, leaving one point for the PC players still waiting.

stories.title: Anthropic closes its first trading day up 17% after a record IPO
stories.summary: Anthropic shares opened at $111.50 and closed at $97.17 on their Nasdaq debut, 17% above the $83 IPO price, Forbes reports.
stories.why: It is the largest IPO on record and the first big public test of how investors value an AI lab.
stories.happened: ANT peaked at $115.10 soon after the open, then fell as low as $93.13 while the wider market slid. It closed with a market value of about $1.27 trillion. The offering raised about $81.3 billion, a US record.
stories.next: Watch for how ANT trades in its first full week and whether the broader AI stock slide continues.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: About $81.3 billion was raised, the largest US IPO on record.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It debuted on a day when the Nasdaq 100 and most AI stocks fell.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Amazon and Google are among Anthropic's biggest shareholders.

stories.background: Anthropic is the San Francisco AI company behind the Claude models.

meme.take: Anthropic's stock rose 17% on its first day, after a short tour of the whole range.

stories.title: Hunger Games prequel opens today with a $100 million-plus debut in sight
stories.summary: Sunrise on the Reaping opens November 20 on about 3,900 US screens, with BoxOfficePro's panel forecasting $100 million to $120 million.
stories.why: It is the big film of the pre-Thanksgiving weekend and a test of the franchise's pull a decade on.
stories.happened: BoxOfficePro says it would be the first $100 million opener since Spider-Man: Brand New Day in July. The film is at 76% on Rotten Tomatoes, ahead of the 64% for The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes, which grossed $347.86 million worldwide.
stories.next: Watch for Thursday preview numbers and Sunday's opening weekend estimate.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Forecasters see the year's first $100 million opening since July.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: It is a prequel to one of the biggest film series of the 2010s.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It opens the same week GTA VI took over the culture.

stories.background: The Hunger Games films are based on Suzanne Collins' novels. This is the second prequel.

meme.top: The odds were once a famous line
meme.take: The Hunger Games returns, and the odds are once again in Lionsgate's favour.

stories.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon with a 1 million token context window
stories.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Neon, its new model, at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output, rolling out in its API and Gemini apps.
stories.why: It is Google's answer to new flagships from OpenAI and Anthropic released in the same week.
stories.happened: Gemini 4 Neon handles 1 million tokens of context. AI Weekly says Artificial Analysis ranks it third on its Intelligence Index, while another report puts it first on a coding agent index; the rankings differ by source.
stories.next: Watch for independent benchmark results that settle where Neon ranks against GPT-6.2 and Claude.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It arrived a day after OpenAI's GPT-6.2 and in the middle of Anthropic's IPO week.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Its $3 input price undercuts OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra at $8.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It is rolling out to Gemini subscribers as well as developers.

stories.background: Gemini is Google's family of AI models and its AI assistant, built by Google DeepMind.

meme.top: Every lab shipped a flagship this week
meme.take: Google's new model ranks first or third, depending on which leaderboard you trust today.

stories.title: GTA VI launch draws nearly 8 million live viewers and breaks a Twitch record
stories.summary: StreamCharts reports nearly 8 million concurrent viewers across five platforms for the GTA VI launch, and it broke Valorant's Twitch record.
stories.why: It shows the launch was as much a live event as a game release.
stories.happened: Riot Games said on X that the 1.7 million viewer Twitch record set by Valorant had been broken. The viewer count across platforms is StreamCharts' estimate.
stories.next: Watch for whether viewing holds up over the first weekend.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Nearly 8 million people were watching at once, StreamCharts estimates.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It broke Valorant's Twitch viewership record.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Many viewers watched others play before getting it themselves.

stories.background: Twitch is Amazon's live-streaming platform, used mostly for gaming.

meme.take: GTA VI drew nearly 8 million viewers, the largest crowd ever to watch someone else drive.

stories.title: Nvidia stops shipping H200 chips to China after a $115.8 billion quarter
stories.summary: Interim CEO Colette Kress said Nvidia plans no further licensed H200 shipments to China, after revenue more than doubled to $115.8 billion.
stories.why: Nvidia's results are read as a check on the whole AI boom, and this one came amid a leadership crisis.
stories.happened: Revenue rose 103% and data center revenue reached $107.6 billion. Nvidia guided to about $130 billion next quarter, excluding China data center sales. The Neuron cites about $2.4 billion in quarterly China sales now at stake.
stories.next: Watch for how shares trade and whether the China exit changes guidance.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Quarterly revenue more than doubled from a year earlier.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It was the first report since Huang resigned.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Leaving China hands that market to local chipmakers.

stories.background: Nvidia designs the GPUs used to train and run most AI models. Kress has been its CFO since 2013.

meme.bottom: the CEO chair is still empty
meme.take: Nvidia posts a record quarter with no permanent CEO, which is bad news for the CEO job market.

stories.title: First trailer for Artificial casts Andrew Garfield as Sam Altman
stories.summary: Neon released the first trailer for Luca Guadagnino's Artificial, a drama about the power struggles at OpenAI.
stories.why: A film about a living tech boss, released as AI dominates the news, is bound to get talked about.
stories.happened: Andrew Garfield plays Sam Altman, with Yura Borisov as Ilya Sutskever, Monica Barbaro as Mira Murati and Ike Barinholtz as Elon Musk. Simon Rich wrote the script.
stories.next: Watch for a release date and how the people portrayed respond.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Guadagnino directed Call Me by Your Name and Challengers.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands in the week of Anthropic's IPO and new OpenAI models.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: It dramatises real, recent events at OpenAI.

stories.background: Neon is the independent distributor behind Parasite and Anora. OpenAI makes ChatGPT.

meme.take: Hollywood turns the OpenAI saga into a film, a product launch with an actual script.

stories.title: Apple's new MacBook Pro is its first laptop with a touchscreen
stories.summary: Apple's new MacBook Pro has a touch-enabled ProLED XDR OLED display and is listed from $2,899, NBC News reports.
stories.why: Apple resisted touchscreen Macs for years, so this is a big shift for its laptops.
stories.happened: NBC News says the laptop is marginally thinner and about half a pound lighter than earlier models, and brings back the light-up Apple logo on the lid.
stories.next: Watch for reviews on how well macOS works with touch.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It is Apple's first laptop with a touchscreen.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The glowing Apple logo is back on the lid.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It starts at $2,899.

stories.background: Apple long argued that touchscreens belonged on iPads, not Macs.

meme.top: Apple said touch Macs made no sense
meme.take: Apple adds a touchscreen to the MacBook Pro and brings back the glowing logo for the occasion.

stories.title: Meta's Muse AI reportedly read Signal messages through Android notifications
stories.summary: Reuters and Ars Technica report that Meta's Muse assistant could read encrypted Signal messages on Android through push notifications.
stories.why: Signal is used precisely because its messages are encrypted, so an assistant reading them is a big privacy concern.
stories.happened: Muse launched in September 2026. According to the reports, Meta staff flagged the problem internally, with one calling it an extreme privacy violation. The issue reportedly came from Muse's access to notifications on Android phones.
stories.next: Watch for Meta's response and whether Signal or privacy regulators act.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Encrypted chats were reportedly exposed through the phone's notifications.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: The warnings reportedly came from Meta's own staff.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Meta's apps are used by billions of people.

stories.background: Meta owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp. Signal is a nonprofit encrypted messaging app.

meme.take: Signal encrypted the messages perfectly, and the AI reportedly read them in the preview.

stories.title: GTA VI runs at 30 frames per second on consoles, even on the PS5 Pro
stories.summary: GTA VI is capped at 30 frames per second on consoles, and Rockstar says even the PS5 Pro is not powerful enough for its simulation at 60.
stories.why: Frame rate is one of the most argued-about topics among console players.
stories.happened: Digital Foundry says the PS5 Pro version looks significantly better with the same frame rate, and the Xbox Series S runs worse than the Series X but is still pretty good. A 60 fps mode is said to be highly unlikely.
stories.next: Watch for performance tests of the eventual PC version.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Many players expected a 60 fps option on the PS5 Pro.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Digital Foundry's analysis is widely followed.

stories.background: Most big console games now offer a 60 frames per second mode.

meme.top: The PS5 Pro was built for this
meme.take: GTA VI runs at 30 on the PS5 Pro, which now looks great while doing exactly the same.

stories.title: Jensen Huang says he would return to Nvidia, but its chair says the board won't
stories.summary: Huang said he is open to returning as CEO if the board wants it; Nvidia's chair said the board will not reinstate him.
stories.why: Who leads the world's key AI chipmaker matters to the whole AI industry and to Washington.
stories.happened: Semafor reports some directors are pushing for his return anyway. The WSJ reports the SEC is probing Nvidia, including its disclosures. Huang agreed to appear before House committees on December 1.
stories.next: Watch for Huang's December 1 testimony and any change in the board's stance.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Huang co-founded Nvidia and led it for 33 years.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: The board is reported to be split on bringing him back.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: An SEC probe and a congressional hearing are both under way.

stories.background: Huang resigned on November 12. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO.

meme.bottom: the board left him on read
meme.take: Jensen Huang is open to returning, and Nvidia's chair is open to not discussing it.

stories.title: GPT-6.2 Astra ranks second behind Claude as early reviews of OpenAI's models split
stories.summary: Artificial Analysis ranks GPT-6.2 Astra No. 2 behind Claude Fable 5.2, while some power users have panned the release, VentureBeat reports.
stories.why: Three frontier labs shipped flagships within a week, and the rankings now shape where developers spend.
stories.happened: Astra costs $8 per million input tokens and $40 output; Sol costs $2 and $10. OpenAI's system card says Astra is its first released model at its High threshold for AI self-improvement, and both reached Critical for cybersecurity.
stories.next: Watch for how GPT-6.2 fares against Google's new Gemini 4 Neon in independent tests.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Artificial Analysis puts Astra just behind Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Both models hit OpenAI's Critical cybersecurity threshold, adding new restrictions.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Astra is priced 20% below GPT-6 Astra, per 9to5Mac.

stories.background: OpenAI makes ChatGPT and the GPT models. Codex is its coding tool.

meme.take: GPT-6.2 Astra is the second-best model, which would be first place in most other industries.

stories.title: Citi, PNC and Citizens say customers carry the losses from third-party AI agents
stories.summary: Three US banks changed their terms so customers are responsible for losses caused by outside AI agents with account access, even if hacked.
stories.why: AI agents that move money are being pitched widely, and this decides who pays when one goes wrong.
stories.happened: TechCrunch reports the new terms apply even when the AI agent itself is compromised. JPMorgan and Bank of America made similar changes in October. Citi exempts its own AI agents from the rule, AI Weekly reports.
stories.next: Watch for whether other banks follow and whether consumer regulators weigh in.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Customers are liable even if the agent is hacked.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Five big US banks have now made similar changes.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It shifts the cost of agent mistakes onto account holders.

stories.background: AI agents are programs that can act for a user, such as logging in to accounts and making payments.

meme.top: Your AI agent can manage your money
meme.bottom: the bank will manage the blame
meme.take: Banks welcome AI agents into your account and leave you to welcome the losses.

stats.label: when JPMorgan and BofA moved first

stories.title: Robert Pattinson is the new James Bond in Denis Villeneuve's 007 film
stories.summary: Amazon MGM Studios named Robert Pattinson as James Bond for the first Bond film made under Amazon, directed by Denis Villeneuve.
stories.why: Bond casting is one of the most debated decisions in film, and this is the first since Daniel Craig left.
stories.happened: Amazon announced the casting on November 16. Steven Knight wrote the script, and Amy Pascal and David Heyman are producing.
stories.next: Watch for a release date, a production start and the rest of the cast.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Pattinson has already played Batman and starred in Twilight.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Bond has been on screen for more than 60 years.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It is the first Bond film produced by Amazon.

stories.background: Amazon took creative control of James Bond in 2025. Villeneuve directed the Dune films.

meme.top: He was a vampire, then Batman
meme.take: Robert Pattinson is Bond, completing the set of brooding, more brooding and shaken.

stories.title: Disney raises its 2027 content budget 9% to $26 billion and licenses films to Netflix
stories.summary: Disney plans to spend $26 billion on content in 2027 and roughly triple its Disney+ international originals over three years, C21 Media reports.
stories.why: Content budgets decide what people get to watch, and Disney is one of the biggest spenders in the business.
stories.happened: Disney also licensed all five Ice Age films, Percy Jackson, and Pixar's Soul and Elio to Netflix. CFO Hugh Johnston said international spending will take time to scale.
stories.next: Watch for which international originals Disney+ greenlights first.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A $26 billion budget for a single year.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Disney is licensing major titles to its streaming rival Netflix.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It plans to roughly triple its international originals.

stories.background: Disney owns Disney+, Hulu, Pixar, Marvel and Lucasfilm.

meme.bottom: and lending Ice Age to Netflix
meme.take: Disney raises its budget 9% and rents its mammoths to the competition.

stats.label: Ice Age films licensed to Netflix

stories.title: PHP fixes seven critical flaws, including one that can allow remote takeover
stories.summary: The PHP project released emergency security updates for all supported versions, fixing flaws that can allow remote code execution on some setups.
stories.why: PHP runs a large share of the world's websites, so even niche flaws affect many servers.
stories.happened: The main flaw, CVE-2026-115560, is rated 9.2 out of 10 and is fixed in PHP 8.2.36, 8.3.37, 8.4.28, 8.5.13 and 8.6.0. PHP says the critical issues need non-default or uncommon configurations.
stories.next: Watch for reports of attacks and how quickly hosting companies roll out the fixes.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Every supported PHP version needed a fix.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: The worst flaw can allow remote code execution.

stories.background: PHP is a programming language that powers WordPress and many other websites.

meme.bottom: patched on the day they said
meme.take: PHP announced its emergency fix a day in advance, the most organised emergency of the week.

stories.title: New York, LA and Chicago schools weigh dropping Google Search over AI features
stories.summary: Three of the largest US school districts are looking at alternatives after Google said schools that opt out of its AI features will lose Search.
stories.why: Schools are one of the most sensitive places for AI, and these districts serve well over a million students.
stories.happened: The New York Times reports that starting next year, schools cannot turn off Gemini-powered features without losing Google Search. The districts in New York City, Los Angeles and Chicago are examining other options.
stories.next: Watch for whether Google changes the policy for schools or a district switches search providers.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: They are three of the largest districts in the country.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Opting out of AI would mean losing Search entirely.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Other search engines get an opening in education.

stories.background: Google's tools, including Chromebooks and Classroom, are widely used in US schools.

meme.top: Schools can turn off the AI
meme.bottom: and the search engine with it
meme.take: Google offers schools a choice between AI in Search or no Search, a classic multiple choice.

stories.title: GTA VI could reach PC in early 2027, a report says
stories.summary: GamesBeat, citing five sources, reports that GTA VI will launch on PC in the first few months of 2027. Rockstar has not announced a date.
stories.why: PC players have historically waited a year or more for Rockstar's games.
stories.happened: PC Gamer relayed the GamesBeat report, which cites five people familiar with the plans. GTA V reached PC about 19 months after its console debut, and Red Dead Redemption 2 about a year after.
stories.next: Watch for any official PC announcement from Rockstar or Take-Two.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: PC players are the only major group still waiting.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It would be a much shorter wait than for past Rockstar games.

stories.background: Rockstar Games is owned by Take-Two Interactive.

meme.take: GTA VI may hit PC in early 2027, which in Rockstar time counts as a same-day release.

stories.title: UK loses its fight to keep its Apple encryption order secret
stories.summary: A UK tribunal ruled the government failed to show that confirming its technical capability notice to Apple would harm national security.
stories.why: The case is a key test of whether governments can force tech companies to weaken encryption in secret.
stories.happened: The Home Office must now acknowledge that it served Apple with the notice, and much of Apple's legal challenge can now proceed in public, MacRumors reports.
stories.next: Watch for the public hearings and whether the UK appeals.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: It concerns a reported government demand for access to encrypted data.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Apple is challenging the UK government directly.

stories.background: A technical capability notice is a UK legal order that can require a company to help with data access.

meme.take: The UK's secret Apple order is now officially less secret, which was never the plan.

stories.title: Ubisoft lays off 166 employees at its Montreal and Quebec City studios
stories.summary: Ubisoft has cut 166 jobs across its Montreal and Quebec City offices, Instant Gaming News reports.
stories.why: Ubisoft's Quebec studios are among the largest in the industry and have made Assassin's Creed games.
stories.happened: The cuts hit two of Ubisoft's biggest studios. They come in a week when another big publisher, Netflix Games, also confirmed layoffs.
stories.next: Watch for which projects are affected and whether further cuts follow.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: 166 jobs at two of Ubisoft's main studios.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Layoffs keep hitting the games industry even in a record launch week.

stories.background: Ubisoft is a French publisher behind Assassin's Creed and Far Cry.

meme.top: The biggest launch week in years
meme.take: Ubisoft cuts 166 jobs in Quebec, in a week the industry otherwise spent celebrating.

stories.title: Google's Gemini can now use apps on your Mac to finish tasks
stories.summary: Gemini for Mac can now operate apps, files and websites in the background to complete multi-step tasks, asking approval before key actions.
stories.why: Letting an AI assistant drive a computer is one of the biggest bets in tech right now.
stories.happened: The feature is for Google AI Plus, Pro and Ultra subscribers in the US, with plans from $4.99 a month, and needs an Apple silicon Mac, MacRumors reports.
stories.next: Watch for how it compares with Apple's own Siri plans and rival agents.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Google is putting its agent directly on Apple's platform.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI assistants that use computers are spreading fast.

stories.background: Gemini is Google's AI assistant. Apple silicon Macs use Apple's own M-series chips.

meme.top: Gemini can now use your Mac
meme.bottom: it will ask before anything big
meme.take: Google's AI can now run your Mac, politely checking in before doing anything you will regret.

stories.title: Palo Alto Networks buys AI startup Applied Compute for $4.5 billion in stock
stories.summary: Palo Alto Networks agreed to buy Applied Compute, a year-old startup that runs custom open-weight models on company data, in an all-stock deal.
stories.why: Security companies are paying up for AI talent, and this is a big price for a very young company.
stories.happened: The WSJ reports the price is $1.25 billion above Applied Compute's valuation from November 2. Palo Alto shares rose about 7% after its earnings, CNBC reports. The deal is subject to adjustments.
stories.next: Watch for regulatory approval and how Palo Alto builds the models into its products.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: $4.5 billion for a startup that is about one year old.

drivers.label: Speed
drivers.text: The price jumped $1.25 billion in about two weeks.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Security firms are racing to add AI.

stories.background: Palo Alto Networks is one of the largest cybersecurity companies in the world.

meme.take: Applied Compute sells for $4.5 billion, outpacing most houses, stocks and one-year-olds.

stories.title: Marvel drops 11 Avengers: Doomsday posters, a month before release
stories.summary: Marvel released 11 character posters for Avengers: Doomsday, plus a featurette on Robert Downey Jr.'s return as Doctor Doom.
stories.why: It is one of the biggest films of the year, and Downey's return in a villain role has fans curious.
stories.happened: Ten posters pair up heroes and one shows Downey's Doom alone. In the featurette, Downey says a film is only as good as its villain. The film opens December 18, and December 16 in China.
stories.next: Watch for a final trailer and early ticket presales.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Downey returns to Marvel after playing Iron Man for over a decade.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: It is the first Avengers team-up film since 2019.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It opens in a month, in the holiday window.

stories.background: Marvel Studios, owned by Disney, makes the Marvel Cinematic Universe films.

meme.top: He saved the universe as Iron Man
meme.bottom: now he is back to threaten it
meme.take: Robert Downey Jr. returns as the villain, because in Marvel nobody leaves, they get recast.

stories.title: Taylor Swift returns to the CMA stage for the first time in 13 years
stories.summary: Swift performed a mashup of 'I Knew It, I Knew You' and her debut-era 'Our Song' at the 60th CMA Awards in Nashville.
stories.why: Swift started in country music, so her return to its biggest night was a major moment for fans.
stories.happened: Lainey Wilson hosted at Bridgestone Arena. The night paid tribute to Dolly Parton, who died in August. Ella Langley won music video of the year for 'Choosin' Texas', and 'McArthur' won musical event.
stories.next: Watch for the full winners list and the clips that travel furthest online.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Swift is one of the biggest music stars in the world.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: She paired a new single with a song from her first album.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It was the 60th edition of the CMA Awards.

stories.background: The CMA Awards are country music's biggest annual awards show.

meme.bottom: and she brought her first song
meme.take: Taylor Swift returned to the CMAs with a song from 2006, ancient history in fan years.

stories.title: Netflix names Peter Rice as its new content chief
stories.summary: Netflix has named veteran TV and film executive Peter Rice as content chief, with a reported hands-on role in its film division.
stories.why: Whoever runs content at Netflix shapes what a huge share of the world streams.
stories.happened: The Hollywood Reporter says Rice is tasked with reviving Netflix's creative output after recent executive departures. Co-CEO Ted Sarandos has said the company's strategy is unchanged.
stories.next: Watch for Rice's first big greenlights and any further changes in Netflix's film team.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Rice previously ran Disney's general entertainment and Fox's TV business.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It follows a run of executive departures at Netflix.

stories.background: Netflix is the world's largest subscription streaming service.

meme.top: Netflix hired a new content chief
meme.bottom: the strategy is unchanged, it says
meme.take: Netflix brings in a new content boss to change things, while confirming nothing is changing.

stories.title: GTA VI's eight Game Awards nominations now come with a 99 review score
stories.summary: GTA VI leads The Game Awards with eight nominations, including Game of the Year, and its reviews have now landed.
stories.why: It is the industry's biggest awards night, and nominating a game before release had sparked debate.
stories.happened: The Game of the Year nominees are 007 First Light, Control Resonant, GTA VI, Phantom Blade Zero, Resident Evil Requiem and the Ocarina of Time remake. The show is on December 10.
stories.next: Watch for fan voting and the winners on December 10.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: GTA VI was nominated before any reviews were published.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Six heavy hitters are competing for Game of the Year.

stories.background: The Game Awards is an annual show hosted by Geoff Keighley, judged by a jury of media outlets.

meme.take: GTA VI was nominated before reviews and then scored 99, a rare gamble that paid out.

stories.title: Broadcom patches a critical VMware vCenter flaw rated 9.8 out of 10
stories.summary: Broadcom fixed an authentication bypass in VMware vCenter's directory service, tracked as CVE-2026-123890, with no workaround available.
stories.why: vCenter manages the virtual machines that many companies run on, which makes it a prime target.
stories.happened: Fixed versions are out for all supported branches. In its advisory Broadcom said it knew of no attacks and no public exploit code, The Hacker News reports.
stories.next: Watch for reports of exploitation and how fast companies apply the patch.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: It is rated 9.8 out of 10, with no workaround.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: vCenter is widely used in company data centers.

stories.background: Broadcom bought VMware, the maker of widely used virtualisation software, in 2023.

meme.bottom: is not a review score here
meme.take: VMware's latest flaw scored 9.8, which is only good news in a GTA VI review.

stories.title: OpenAI says its models are helping redesign parts of its AI chips
stories.summary: OpenAI says an AI-generated circuit redesign cut a chip part's estimated area by about 15% in its chip work with AMD.
stories.why: Using AI to design the chips that run AI could speed up and cut the cost of the whole hardware race.
stories.happened: OpenAI says one AI-designed multiplier shrank estimated area by about 15% and cut a calculation from two clock cycles to one. The work is for its Jalapeño chip effort with AMD, and it is also working with Synopsys on design software.
stories.next: Watch for whether the redesigned parts make it into shipping chips.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: AI is being used to design parts of the chips it runs on.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: AMD and Synopsys are involved in the work.

stories.background: AMD is a major maker of processors and AI chips. Synopsys makes software used to design chips.

meme.top: The AI helped design its own chip
meme.bottom: and asked for a smaller one
meme.take: OpenAI's models shaved 15% off a chip part, which is how you get a raise in hardware.

stories.title: California bans Waymo robotaxis from freeways, and Waymo pauses them nationwide
stories.summary: California's DMV barred Waymo's driverless cars from state freeways, calling them an imminent hazard; Waymo paused freeway rides in all markets.
stories.why: It is a major setback for robotaxis in their biggest home market.
stories.happened: The DMV cited three Waymo cars entering an active construction zone on Highway 101 and one trying to pass a highway patrol blockade on I-280. Waymo says no one was hurt and surface-street rides continue.
stories.next: Watch for what Waymo must show the DMV to get freeway service back.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Regulators called freeway operations an imminent hazard.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Waymo paused freeway rides across the US, not just California.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: A viral video of the I-280 incident spread widely.

stories.background: Waymo is the self-driving car company owned by Alphabet, Google's parent.

meme.top: A robotaxi tried to pass the police
meme.take: Waymo is banned from California freeways, the one traffic jam it can now skip.

stories.title: Microsoft unveils seven of its own AI models at Ignite, aimed at OpenAI and Anthropic
stories.summary: Microsoft launched seven in-house AI models at Ignite 2026, including MAI Code 2 and Code 2 Flash for software work.
stories.why: Microsoft is OpenAI's biggest backer, so building rival models of its own is a notable shift.
stories.happened: The set covers coding, cybersecurity, image generation and voice. ZDNET reports Microsoft says its new coding model rivals Claude Opus 5.5 at about 5% of the cost. Code 2 Flash targets routine fixes at a lower price.
stories.next: Watch for independent tests of Microsoft's cost and quality claims.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Microsoft now competes directly with the labs it partners with.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It claims near-rival coding quality at about 5% of the cost.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Seven models were launched at once.

stories.background: Ignite is Microsoft's yearly conference for business customers and developers.

meme.bottom: to compete with the AI it invested in
meme.take: Microsoft launches seven models, giving its OpenAI investment something new to worry about.

stories.title: Stallone biopic I Play Rocky goes wide with a $15 million to $20 million forecast
stories.summary: Amazon MGM's I Play Rocky expands nationwide this weekend after earning nearly $1 million on fewer than 30 screens.
stories.why: It is a well-reviewed film about how one of cinema's best-known underdog stories got made.
stories.happened: BoxOfficePro reports an 87% critic score and a 98% audience score. Its forecast for the wide expansion is $15 million to $20 million, opening against the Hunger Games prequel.
stories.next: Watch for its opening weekend total and whether it holds into Thanksgiving.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: It tells the story behind the original Rocky.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Its audience score is a reported 98%.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It goes wide against the Hunger Games prequel.

stories.background: Rocky (1976) was written by and starred Sylvester Stallone and won the Oscar for best picture.

meme.top: A film about the ultimate underdog
meme.take: I Play Rocky goes wide against a franchise giant, which is at least on brand.

stories.title: Apple's iCloud, App Store and Apple Pay go down after an internal update
stories.summary: An Apple outage broke iCloud sign-in for users and disrupted the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay and AppleCare on November 17.
stories.why: Apple accounts underpin payments, backups and logins on a huge number of devices.
stories.happened: Devices signed people out at random during the outage. Apple ruled out a cyberattack and blamed an internal update. Most services were restored by late afternoon Eastern time, 9to5Mac reports.
stories.next: Watch for whether Apple publishes more detail on what the update changed.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: iCloud sign-in failed for all users, 9to5Mac reports.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It landed in a week already full of major outages.

stories.background: iCloud is Apple's service for syncing and backing up data across its devices.

meme.take: Apple says the outage was an internal update, the one attacker no firewall can stop.

stories.title: Google opens its Genie 4 world model to AI Ultra subscribers
stories.summary: Google's Genie 4 lets AI Ultra subscribers generate interactive worlds, change them with text while exploring, and hear responsive audio.
stories.why: Interactive world models are one of the most visible new uses of AI, with obvious links to games.
stories.happened: Project Genie adds a world-building agent and a community gallery for sharing creations. The Decoder calls it Google DeepMind's most realistic world model so far.
stories.next: Watch for what subscribers build and whether game studios start experimenting with it.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: World models are a fast-growing area of AI research.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: It is the first time paying users can try Genie 4 directly.

stories.background: Google DeepMind is Google's AI research lab. AI Ultra is Google's top AI subscription.

meme.top: You can now generate a whole world
meme.bottom: if you have an Ultra plan
meme.take: Google lets subscribers build entire worlds, a feature previously limited to the very bored.

stories.title: YouTube will add estimated group viewers on TVs to its view counts
stories.summary: YouTube will count estimated viewers watching together on connected TVs, using statistical modelling rather than cameras or microphones.
stories.why: View counts drive creator pay and advertising, so changing how they are counted matters to the whole platform.
stories.happened: The change applies to long-form videos, Shorts and livestreams, but only to new views on TVs, The Verge reports. YouTube says it does not use cameras or microphones to make the estimates.
stories.next: Watch for how much view counts rise and how advertisers react.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: View counts feed into advertising and creator deals.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: More YouTube watching is happening on living room TVs.

stories.background: YouTube is Google's video platform and one of the most-watched services on TVs.

meme.top: YouTube can now count your family
meme.bottom: without being able to see them
meme.take: YouTube will estimate who else is on the sofa, a statistic no family has ever agreed on.

stories.title: Netflix Games confirms another round of layoffs
stories.summary: Netflix's gaming division has carried out a new round of layoffs, Instant Gaming News reports; no headcount was given.
stories.why: Netflix has spent heavily on games and its commitment to them is closely watched.
stories.happened: Instant Gaming News reports the cuts but gives no number of affected staff. They land in the same week Ubisoft cut 166 jobs in Quebec.
stories.next: Watch for whether Netflix narrows its game plans further.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: It is the second big games layoff story of the week.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Netflix is the world's largest streaming service.

stories.background: Netflix began offering games to subscribers in 2021.

meme.take: Netflix Games trims staff again, still searching for its first binge-worthy hit.

stories.title: Ebenezer is forecast to drop about half in its second weekend
stories.summary: Johnny Depp's Ebenezer is forecast at $8 million to $13 million in its second weekend, falling to third as the Hunger Games prequel arrives.
stories.why: It is a rare box office win for Depp and a test of how a mid-budget holiday film holds up.
stories.happened: The Ti West film opened at No. 1 with $19 million in the US, slightly under expectations, BoxOfficePro says. It has an A- CinemaScore and 53% on Rotten Tomatoes.
stories.next: Watch for how it holds over the Thanksgiving holiday next week.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It faces the Hunger Games prequel this weekend.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It cost a reported $38 million.

stories.background: Ebenezer is a new take on Charles Dickens' A Christmas Carol.

meme.bottom: then the ghost of week two
meme.take: Ebenezer is set to drop sharply, a lesson in thrift its main character would respect.

stories.title: N-able confirms hackers accessed a server in its email security cloud
stories.summary: N-able said unknown attackers accessed one server in its Mail Assure and SpamExperts hosted cloud, and it disabled management tools.
stories.why: N-able's tools are used by IT service companies that manage many businesses, so one breach can reach far.
stories.happened: The disruption began November 16 and N-able disclosed the access on November 18. It says it has no evidence customer data, including mailboxes, was compromised. The investigation is ongoing.
stories.next: Watch for the findings of N-able's investigation and when management tools return.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Its products sit between many businesses and their email.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It is one of several security incidents disclosed this week.

stories.background: N-able makes remote management and security software for IT service providers.

meme.bottom: needed some security of its own
meme.take: N-able's email protection cloud was accessed by attackers, and is now under protection itself.

stories.title: Canal+ seeks 137 million euros from Disney over former subscribers' emails
stories.summary: Canal+ is suing Disney in Paris, alleging it used emails of customers who activated Disney+ through Canal+ to sign them up directly.
stories.why: It is a fight over who owns the customer when streaming bundles end, a common setup across Europe.
stories.happened: The claim covers customers from 2020 to 2024. Disney says those users gave their details to activate its service, and it separately claims 7.6 million euros in unpaid fees. The court declined to merge the two cases.
stories.next: Watch for the Paris commercial court's ruling on either claim.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Canal+ is seeking 137 million euros.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Former partners are now fighting over the same subscribers.

stories.background: Canal+ is France's biggest pay-TV group and bundled Disney+ for several years.

meme.take: Canal+ and Disney are in court over who gets to send the reminder emails.

stories.title: Crimson Desert wins eight Korea Game Awards, including Game of the Year
stories.summary: Pearl Abyss's Crimson Desert took eight prizes at the Korea Game Awards, including the top award.
stories.why: It is a big win for South Korea's console-style games as the global awards season begins.
stories.happened: The open-world action game swept the ceremony with eight awards, Instant Gaming News reports.
stories.next: Watch for whether it picks up more honours this awards season.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It leads a strong year for South Korean games.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Awards season runs up to The Game Awards on December 10.

stories.background: Pearl Abyss is the South Korean studio behind Black Desert Online.

meme.bottom: the trophy shelf is now a wall
meme.take: Crimson Desert wins eight Korea Game Awards, leaving the other nominees to share the parking.

stories.title: Apple's Black Friday event offers gift cards up to $300 from November 27
stories.summary: Apple's four-day Black Friday event runs November 27 to 30, with US gift cards of up to $300 on eligible purchases, MacRumors reports.
stories.why: Apple rarely cuts prices directly, so its holiday gift card offer is the main deal many shoppers watch for.
stories.happened: The iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max and iPhone Duo are excluded. The gift cards can only be used on future purchases.
stories.next: Watch for the full list of eligible products and gift card amounts.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Gift cards reach up to $300 in the US.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It covers Black Friday through Cyber Monday weekend.

stories.background: Apple has run a gift card promotion instead of price cuts for Black Friday for years.

meme.bottom: is a reason to shop at Apple again
meme.take: Apple offers up to $300 back, in the form of money you can only spend at Apple.

stories.title: Google will keep Gemini chats for two months even with history turned off
stories.summary: Gemini users can now opt out of training without losing history, but temporary chats will be kept for about two months instead of 72 hours.
stories.why: Many people use temporary chats for privacy, so a much longer retention window matters.
stories.happened: Google updated its Gemini Privacy Hub. Chats with history off and temporary chats stay on Google's servers for about two months, mainly for safety and service operations. Separately, users can keep history while opting out of model training.
stories.next: Watch for whether privacy regulators in Europe question the longer retention period.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Temporary chats now last about 20 times longer on Google's servers.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Gemini is built into Android and Google's apps.

stories.background: Gemini is Google's AI assistant and model family.

meme.take: Google will keep temporary chats for two months, which is a generous reading of temporary.

stories.title: 007 First Light wins Game of the Year at the TIGA Awards
stories.summary: IO Interactive's James Bond game 007 First Light was voted Game of the Year by attendees at the UK's TIGA Awards.
stories.why: It is a strong signal for Bond's first big game in years as it competes at The Game Awards.
stories.happened: The award was voted for by attendees of the TIGA Awards, which celebrate the UK games industry. The game is also a Game of the Year nominee at The Game Awards.
stories.next: Watch for how it fares at The Game Awards on December 10.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It is a James Bond game from the makers of Hitman.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It came the same week Amazon named a new screen Bond.

stories.background: TIGA is the trade association for UK games developers.

meme.top: Bond has a new actor in films
meme.take: 007 First Light wins a Game of the Year award, so this Bond at least is settled.

stories.title: MindsEye developer Build A Rocket Boy reportedly owes 62 million pounds
stories.summary: A new filing shows Build A Rocket Boy, the studio behind MindsEye, owes about 62 million pounds, Instant Gaming News reports.
stories.why: The studio's struggles are a high-profile example of how expensive new games can go wrong.
stories.happened: The document puts the debt at 62 million pounds, about 74.4 million euros. A possible closure of the studio was flagged in September.
stories.next: Watch for news on the studio's future and the game's support.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The reported debt is 62 million pounds.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: A possible closure was flagged in September.

stories.background: Build A Rocket Boy is a UK studio founded by former Rockstar North president Leslie Benzies.

meme.top: GTA VI made $2 billion on day one
meme.take: The games industry this week: one studio counting billions, another counting debts.
